hotel_name: The Central View Hotel And Banquets

positive_snippets:
It's a newly built Hotel cum Banquet at a very strategic location in Faridabad. Good connection with Metro station & convenient for locals.
Excellent peaceful place with ample parking space. Food quality is excellent.

The hotel was decent overall, especially for the price point. The room was clean and the bed was comfortable, but some areas could use a little updating. Staff were friendly and check-in was smooth, though service was a bit slow at times. The location was convenient, close to restaurants and public transport. Breakfast was basic but acceptable. Not a luxury experience, but a solid choice for budget-conscious travelers who still want comfort and cleanliness.
The place was very nice and clean , staff were very friendly and corporative, great for functions, must visit.
